Verbatim-ready revision directive:

REVISE; do not pivot. Retain the field-tier topic stat_spectral_hte_bands/fixed_error_minimax_width: an honest, minimax-width band for a Hölder treatment-slope curve under fixed nonvanishing supplied treatment-code error, using spectral contour cancellation and no outcome learner.

1. Separate the law class from the supplied code. Remove ass:conditional-code-radius from the definition of the probability-law class. Fix in advance a nontrivial, procedure-independent candidate class G ⊆ [-Cg,Cg]^(X×[0,1]), define dP(g,g0) as ess sup over v of E_P[|g(X,V)-g0(X,V)| | V=v], and define the primitive law class with a_G(P)=inf_{g∈G} dP(g,g0) ≤ eps_app, where G and eps_app are fixed independently of the realized code. Separately define admissible construction inputs Gamma(P,eps0)={g∈G:dP(g,g0)≤eps0}, with eps_app<eps0. The band theorem and honesty class must quantify uniformly over pairs (P,gbar_n) with P in P_law and gbar_n in Gamma(P,eps0), fixed before the inference sample. Use essential supremum unless imposing a continuous conditional-risk version. Retag conditional-L1 as a new stronger condition, not standard Jin–Mackey–Syrgkanis. Give a substantive auxiliary-training or frozen-predictor example implying the law-level property. If implementable code learning is claimed, prove a separate auxiliary-sample placement result; otherwise say the theorem is conditional on an admissible external input.

2. Remove epsbar/contour-bank circularity. First state and prove a noise-only quantitative contour-bank lemma from (k,delta,psi_eta) that outputs a finite bank C0, maximal radius R0<∞, boundary modulus rho_M>0, nonzero winding, and the derivative/length envelope, uniformly over admissible treatment-noise laws. Only then define eps_star=min{1,cV/CV}/(4 R0 exp(2 Cg R0))>0 and independently fix eps0 in (0,eps_star]. The robust bank may take this already-fixed eps0 as input; eps0 is never delivered by that bank. Prove contaminated moduli as outputs using |exp(zD)-1|≤R0 exp(2CgR0)|D| for D=g0-gbar_n, obtaining the unconditional contamination factor ≥1/2, localized kernel factor ≥cV/2 for small h, selected-contour modulus ≥rho_M/2, and localized denominator modulus ≥rho_M cV/2. The good contour, positive moduli, localized denominator safety, pilot selection consistency, and explicit B_bias envelope remain proof obligations, not assumptions.

3. Repair the exact-code reduction without restricting k. Keep every fixed k≥3. Use a k-dependent asymmetric bounded law: B~Bernoulli(pk), eta=ak(B-pk), with pk∈(1/4,3/4) outside the finite zero set of the k-th derivative at zero of log(1-p+p exp(t)). Then eta is centered, bounded, sub-Gaussian, nonzero a.s., and has nonzero k-th cumulant. Choose ak to meet tail and separation constants and state the ordinary compatibility condition. On the exact-code subclass set g0=gbar_n=q0=0, T=eta, Y=eta{tau0(V)+epsilon}, epsilon~N(0,sigma²) independent. Then xi=eta epsilon meets conditional tails/variance after scaling and R=Y/T=tau0(V)+epsilon. The observation experiment is ordinary random-design Gaussian nonparametric regression plus ancillary T, yielding the classical honest Hölder-band lower rate for every allowed k, including odd k.

4. Add Ai–Huang–Zhang (2026), arXiv:2602.01595, to bibliography, checklist, related work, and comparator table. State non-overlap both ways: they obtain uniform Bahadur/bootstrap bands and data-driven bias control for continuous-treatment causal functions via estimated minimum-variance balancing weights, but not localized contour cancellation for a fixed persistently erroneous supplied code with no outcome learner; this proposal assumes additive independent non-Gaussian treatment residual and fixed cumulant separation and does not cover their broader model. Do not claim dominance. The contribution is the fixed-code/no-outcome-learner spectral regime plus an all-honest-band expected-sup-width converse.

5. Preserve the hard content and field tier. Retain the same upper band, all-measurable-band minimax lower bound, and fixed positive code-error radius; do not make eps0 vanish or retreat to exact code in the main theorem. Expose as theorem/lemma outputs the quantitative noise-only bank, conditional-L1 robustness, uniform localized denominator control, selector error, uniform Bahadur/multiplier approximation, Hölder bias, and many-bump converse. Do not assume a safe contour, positive boundary modulus, or procedure-certified code. Keep weak-separation as an incremental open question.
